name: Avalanche

abilities.name: Ice Shards
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals moderate frost damage.

abilities.name: Hoarfrost Fist
abilities.description: The boss swings its arm around dealing very high frost damage as indicated by a cone. Avoid this if possible even as a tank.

abilities.name: Glacial Cage
abilities.description: The boss stomps and summons a ring of ice around its target. It will then swing it arms hitting its LEFT, then the BACK/RIGHT/LEFT, and finally hitting the RIGHT side (directions assuming the boss is facing you). Leaving the ring before the attack is over will kill the target.

abilities.name: Glacial Prison
abilities.description: The boss places its fist in the ground and summons a small ice ball that rolls towards a target dealing moderate frost damage. If every player touches the frost ball before the fight ends, it will net players the Cold Potato achievement.

related_quests: Lock and Keystone: Search the depths of a Dwemer vault for a powerful artifact.
Pledge: Frostvault: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Frostvault.
summary: Avalanche is a powerful Frost Atronach that accompanies the Riekling mage Rizzuk Bonechill in Frostvault. It makes use of many deadly unique frost-based attacks. When Rizzuk is killed, Avalanche will crumble and die immediately afterwards.
